author: reactive-end
summary: db init detects the engine (env vars, DATABASE_URL scheme, dependencies) and the connection (project env file, else local defaults filling gaps); anvil db serve starts Toolbox with that connection and is the anvil-db MCP entry; Stop blocks backend edits of DB projects until tools file, a scenario and a passing run after the edit exist; Toolbox errors keep their detail lines. Verified in tests-anvil (sqlite detection, MCP round trip, gate block/unblock) and against local Postgres (connects, auth refused with SQLSTATE 28P01).
